purpose: eligibility and data-health metadata only; never candidate scoring

signal_contract.bar_time: closed-bar UTC close time (bar open + 300 seconds)
signal_contract.outputs: counts and coverage only; no entries, exits, labels, PnL, or replay

causal_regimes.ATR: 14-period simple mean of true range through the closed signal bar
causal_regimes.EMA: standard recursive EMA on closed M5 close values, spans 20 and 50
causal_regimes.uptrend: EMA20 > EMA50 and EMA50 change over 12 bars / ATR14 > 0.1
causal_regimes.downtrend: EMA20 < EMA50 and EMA50 change over 12 bars / ATR14 < -0.1
causal_regimes.volatility_reference: median ATR14 over the preceding 288 closed M5 bars; current bar excluded
causal_regimes.warmup_missing_policy: no regime bucket until every required lookback is finite; maturity cannot pass while required signals are unclassified

quality.valid_tick: finite time/time_msc, finite bid and ask, 0 < bid <= ask
quality.valid_bar: finite positive OHLC and low <= open/close <= high
quality.duplicate_ticks: count and report; never silently deduplicate
quality.session_calendar: separate authoritative XM US30Cash UTC weekly schedule and holiday/early-close artifact required for gap acceptance
